pages.ja:
飼育箱で夢を見る。
廃墟の巣穴。
黒色の蛹。
誕生の記憶はない。
繁栄にあつく。
ルーツは原初からして不明。
滅日の記憶はない。
pages.en:
I dream inside the rearing box.

A ruined nest.

A chrysalis of black.

No memory of birth.

Devoted to proliferation.

Its origins unknown from the beginning.

No memory of extinction.

pages.en:
Patter, patter, I go walking.

　　　　　　My swaying head is empty,

　　　　　　and any rigid purpose drifts far away.

　　　　　　Shiver and tremble, roar and go.

　　　　　　My dry limbs, light as paper balloons,

　　　　　　roll and tumble over the ground.

　　　　I will flutter through the air once I am properly grown.

　　　　　　　　　　　　Roar, roar.

　　　　　　　　　　　　Roar, roar.

　　　　　　　　　　　　Roar, roar.

“Hey. Lo—hey, look at that. What—what's with her?”

　　　　　　　Squeak, squeak, someone draws near.

“Whoa, she's hot. Barefoot? Shit—look at her face—”

　　　　　　　Shuffle, shuffle, more people gather.

“—Yeah. Killing time—want some company—?”

　　　　　　　Dry laughter rattles.

　　　　　　　I do not remember inviting them.

　　　　　　　I have become frightened, so I shall go home.

“Hey—why're you run—hold it—you—”

“Wait, damn it—! What, are you deaf, you li—!”

“Ain't she—? If she wasn't, she wouldn't walk around town dressed li—”

“Hahaha! Right—exactly, which means—we gotta take her into protection—don't we?”

“Agreed! I—want to protect people in trou—!”

　　　　“—Ha—ha　　　ha—!”

　　　　“Ah—ha　　haha——!”

　　　　“Ahahaha—hahaha—hahahahahaha—”

　　　　“Ahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!”

　　　　　　Step by step, they follow me.

　　　　　　Their voices ring so shrill and loud

　　　　　　that my stomach gives an empty growl.

“——————!!!!????”

“Wai—stop—what, ngh—gi!?”

“N-no—don't run, damn you, help m—eeee!”

“Wh-what, where did you all g—

giiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!”

“N-no, please, I-I'm sorry, nooooooooooooo!!!!???”
I dream of the rearing box.
[Control-only interlude exit and return page; no reader-facing text.]
